broadAcknowledgement.scope: all commercially approved LPC and OpenGameArt contributors available to Havenwild development

rules: Broad acknowledgment is additive and never replaces exact attribution.
Unused approved contributors may be acknowledged in the master catalog.
Release-specific credits must identify every shipped attributed source.
Modified or composited ShareAlike artwork must retain applicable ShareAlike treatment.
Credits should be grouped to remain readable while preserving traceability.
The game may remain commercially distributed under Havenwild's chosen code and content licenses.
